title: China launches mass production of ASML-like lithography machines #ASML #ChinaChips #semiconductors
description: ASML controls the advanced chip lithography market with its exclusive immersion deep-ultraviolet machines for two decades. A Shanghai state-owned company has now started mass-producing a similar machine, challenging ASML’s monopoly by offering a product four generations behind but significant enough to shift industry dynamics. This development marks a critical turning point in semiconductor technology, as China takes its first steps toward self-sufficiency in chip production amidst rising geopolitical tensions. Although the Chinese machines currently handle older chip nodes, their emergence introduces new leverage in global chip supply negotiations. The industry now faces questions about how quickly China can close the technological gap and impact the future of advanced semiconductor manufacturing. The shift could influence global supply chains, technology access, and the balance of power in the semiconductor market, making it a key story for investors, tech companies, and policymakers worldwide. #ASML #SemiconductorIndustry #ChipTechnology #ChinaTech #LithographyMachines #DeepUltravioletLithography #AdvancedChips #ChipManufacturing #TechMonopoly #Geopolitics #SemiconductorSupplyChain #ChinaSemiconductors #TechInnovation #GlobalTech #SiliconIndustry
